# cpanel_locale (Resource)

Manages the display locale for the cPanel account. Removing the resource restores the locale observed when Terraform first took ownership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_locale" "account" {
  locale = "fr"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `locale` (String) The abbreviated locale name returned by cPanel `Locale::list_locales`.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) The singleton account identity, always `account`.
- `direction` (String) The locale text direction: `ltr` or `rtl`.
- `encoding` (String) The character encoding reported by cPanel.
- `local_name` (String) The locale name written in its own language.
- `name` (String) The locale name translated into the current cPanel locale.
- `restore_locale` (String) The locale that Terraform restores when the resource is removed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_locale.account account
```
